notes: 2 Then said he unto me, Son of man, these [are] the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
11 This [city] shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; [but] I will judge you in the border of Israel:

This is the first mention of a future restoration in the book of Ezekiel. God makes four specific promises to the remnant: 1. To gather them (9:17a) 2. To restore them to the Land (9:17b) 3. To cleanse the Land of abominations (9:18a) 4. To initiate a new covenant with them (9:19; see also Jeremiah 31:31-34) - This new covenant would consist of two parts: a. A change of heart b. The outpouring of His Spirit

Ezekiel 11:17 17 Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
